metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate from 16 channels using a standard 1020 montage with g.USBamp (g.tec) hardware. The experimental paradigm employed a 6x6 checkerboard visual stimulus presentation with target and non-target event classifications. Data were collected in a laboratory setting with online feedback provided to subjects. Trial intervals were defined as [0, 1.0] seconds with a 60 Hz line frequency.
